## Appearance

Carrow is a remarkably tall, brown-haired man with broad shoulders and an open-faced appearance. He has bright, direct hazel eyes that convey a serious depth.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 ch.Nell-girl P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003)_

## Personality

Carrow is a perpetually cheerful individual with a generous, considerate nature and a strong appreciation for humor, though he is also known to be teasing. Driven by a desire to become a doctor, he is motivated to fight illness, suffering, and ignorance. To support his ambitions, he funds his own college education and focuses intensely on his studies to achieve High Honors and the Cooper Prize.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014), [v3 ch.Charming P25](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0025), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), +1 more_

## History

During his youth, Hugh spent three years in Alberta with his ill father, during which he scarcely attended school. In his past, he also survived a severe fever, recited poetry during a school performance, and rescued [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) from a pond. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was also once forced to sit next to Hugh as a disciplinary measure during their school days. On the eve of their wedding, Hugh met with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) before they moved into their new house near [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor), riding together in a buggy to their home where they were welcomed over supper by [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), Mrs. Doctor Dave, and Captain Saul. Settling into their new life, Hugh shared his pride with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over saving a patient's life overnight and eavesdropped from an adjoining room while Miss Winifred [Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) visited. He later accompanied [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on walks to the [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) light to visit Captain Saul, and listened as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shared her impressions of their neighbor [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md). Over the winter, Hugh hosted a successful first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for their friends, carefully carving the geese under Nell's instructions despite having baited Miss Winifred alongside Captain Saul beforehand. On New Year's Eve, Hugh, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) walked to the lighthouse, catching a rare glimpse of Venus's shadow on their way to celebrate with Captain Saul and [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md). Across the seasons, Hugh continued to join [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), their friends, and visitor [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) on coastal outings as Adrian worked on a book. Hugh later delivered the news to [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) that [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md) might recover, leading to her decision to take Rufus to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for surgery. After returning from a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) spent in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), Hugh later joined [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), Captain Saul, and Adrian by the hearth, where Captain Saul bestowed a blessing upon the gathered couples.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v2 IV Different Opinions P24](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P30](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P0](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), +56 more_

## Quotes

> "From that point on I anticipated the next day. When I departed from you at your gate that evening and strolled home I was the most joyful youth on earth. Nell had forgiven me."
>
> — Carrow — [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P62](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0062)

> “Did she belong to the tale I’ve heard tied to this dwelling?” Hugh inquired. “I was told by someone that you could relate it, Captain Saul.”
>
> — Carrow — [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P1](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0001)

> "did you happen to pour what Uncle Dave terms 'a little of the Scott Act’ into the lemonade you handed me right before we departed from the house?"
>
> — Carrow — [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014)

> "Based on what you are telling me, I imagine she got married prior to being mature enough to understand her own mind or feelings, only to discover when it was too late that she had erred. It happens to be a quite frequent tragedy, Nell."
>
> — Carrow — [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P63](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0063)

> "Being in this place with merely you and me is wonderful, Hugh. Having another person around ruins it somewhat. Although Tabitha is a lovely person, she remains a stranger. Performing the chores in this house will not harm me."
>
> — Carrow — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P1](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0001)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carrow--nell-harcourt.md)

Carrow and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) began as academic rivals competing for top marks in school, during which time she temporarily despised him following an incident despite his attempt to make amends and his act of saving her. Their dynamic eventually shifted into a friendly relationship, with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) expressing concern for him during an inquiry about blue hall paint. Though early records ambiguously note her as his spouse, there is no evidence of a romantic relationship between them in their shared interactions.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P26](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0026), +44 more_
